calendarNotes: The 2027–28 CCSD All Schools calendar starts students on August 16, 2027, after teacher work days from August 9–13. Fall Break is October 18–22. K–8 non-contact or conference dates include November 12, March 2–3, and May 5. K–12 non-contact dates include November 24, January 3, and February 22. Winter Break runs December 20–31, with the second semester beginning January 4. Spring Break runs March 20–24, and the last student day is May 26.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2026–27
content: The first student day moves one day earlier, from August 17 to August 16.
The last student day moves two days earlier, from May 28 to May 26.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Cherry Creek School District start in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day on the 2027–28 All Schools calendar is Monday, August 16, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Cherry Creek Winter Break in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 20–31, 2027. January 3 is a K–12 non-contact day, and the second semester begins January 4, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of Cherry Creek school in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day on the All Schools calendar is Friday, May 26, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When are the CCSD K–8 conference dates in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The PDF marks November 12, 2027, March 2–3, 2028, and May 5, 2028, as K–8 non-contact or conference dates.

calendarFaqs.q: What is the difference between K–12 and K–8 non-contact dates?
calendarFaqs.a: K–12 non-contact dates apply to students in grades K–12. K–8 non-contact or conference dates apply to elementary and middle school students, while high schools may follow a different schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: Does this calendar include school-specific Cherry Creek events?
calendarFaqs.a: No. This page summarizes the All Schools calendar. Check your assigned school or program calendar for A/B schedules, testing, exams, graduation, and campus-specific events.
